basic_info.description: Endless Potential in the Heart of San Francisco - Duplex Opportunity!    Welcome to 912 Alabama St, a duplex located in one of San Francisco's most vibrant and sought-after neighborhoods. This property is brimming with potential and offers the perfect opportunity to create your dream home or a smart investment.    Live in one unit and rent the other, or lease both for strong rental incomethe choice is yours. Each unit offers flexibility for a variety of living arrangements or income strategies. Whether you're an investor or an owner-occupant, this is a rare chance to add value in a prime location.    Enjoy being just minutes away from Whole Foods, San Francisco General Hospital, and the lively 24th Street corridor, known for its eclectic mix of restaurants, cafes, boutiques, and cultural charm.    Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity to own a piece of San Francisco with endless upside!
